note: AGX instruction latencies in ns, measured 2026-10-30 by perf/agx-latency/bench.swift on M4 Pro (one simdgroup, dependent chains, clocks warmed; perf/agx-latency.txt in results/perfmodel-oct30). Opcode numbers = the backend's MIR opcodes (agx-nt-opt.py mir of kernels.metal). issue = ns per instruction from one simdgroup (fma indep4: 0.89). MMA (2884 half->float, 860 half->half): latency 11.7, and one simdgroup starts back-to-back MMAs 11.7 ns apart (16 clocks; mma_interval_measured, mma16_regs). The simulator does NOT enforce that spacing (mma_pipe 0 = an MMA costs one issue slot): enforced in program order it over-predicts the skinny k-steps 16-27%, unenforced they land within 7% on 5 of 7 - the real tiles overlap their MMA groups with the following dequant in a way the in-order model cannot express (kernel-perf-model.md 2026-10-30 evening; the earlier 3.2 ns issue figure came from probes whose four identical accumulator chains the compiler folded into one).
